# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure at Rosewood Street Bakery

**Report ID:** RSB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 12, 2024
**Date of Report:** March 18, 2024
**Prepared by:** Facilities & Operations Review Team
**Classification:** Internal — Quality & Safety

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 11:40 p.m. on March 12, the walk-in cooler at Rosewood Street Bakery experienced a compressor failure that went undetected until staff arrived at 4:15 a.m. the following morning. Internal temperatures rose from a normal operating range of 36–38°F to a peak of 61°F over roughly four and a half hours. As a precaution, the bakery discarded all temperature-sensitive inventory, including dairy products, custards, cream-filled pastries, and par-baked laminated doughs. No products reached customers, and no illnesses were reported. The bakery opened two hours late and operated on a reduced menu.

This report reconstructs the event, examines contributing factors across systems and procedures rather than individuals, and recommends changes to reduce the likelihood of recurrence.
